verification.priorArt: RE-DONE 2026-09-02 against the current draft; the earlier sweep judged V1-V9, a different proposal. Nearest neighbour on the projection side is ERC-5805 with ERC-6372, never checked before: it requires past values to be immutable, which it can because the chain writes them, and which this ERC cannot because the register does not. Finality is vacuous there and decidable here. ERC-3643, ERC-6065 and ERC-8106 checked and distinct; ERC-6065 states outright that it needs a trusted party to keep the mirror true.

verification.quiescence: ADDED / an interval with no gap open at its start and none begun in it cannot admit an entry, so governance can constitute a register closure with no new primitive; the act constituting it cannot be protected by it, so the contested rule is the floor (ADR-008 addendum)
verification.scopeDiscipline: ADR-009 applied / every normative statement tested against 'does it say who holds power, or what you must do'; the rights section went from 6 MUSTs to 2 and the spec from 34 to 30; no interface changed
verification.oracleBoundary: CORRECTED / the Motivation had framed oracles as a path this ERC escapes; it does not. A register without consensus needs an attesting party, its contents often cannot be published, and the proof verifies that party's committed statements. Normative load unchanged at 30 MUSTs; reference header comment only, runtime bytecode byte-identical.
verification.attestationVsVerification: CORRECTED / an earlier caution assumed an LLM extractor and is withdrawn; the profile definition no longer excludes constraining how a value is produced, since pinning a deterministic procedure is what makes a mechanical attester reproducible

verification.preSubmissionReview: APPLIED 2026-09-02 / external pre-submission review. Removed the unused NonReceiverContract fixture from the normative reference file. Settlement authority decoupled from ERC-721 authorization and exposed as isSettlementAuthority, because a registrar that cannot open a gap cannot record a change its own register made, and ownerOf-derived authority hands the withholding position to every new buyer. Finality checkpoint moved to a full EIP-712 domain bound to chain and contract. Merkle leaves and nodes tagged, and the membership index must be exhausted. cancelSettlement lost the parameter that had to be empty. effectiveAt bounded ahead of the present. IProjectionSettlement id changed 0xfd0f6337 to 0xf4a7d71b; IRegisterProjection unchanged. VERIFICATION_PROFILE bumped to v2 because the proof rules changed. Four regression tests added.

userPrinciples.attestingPartyPreference: a deterministic rule-based AI oracle first (not an LLM), then human attestation under dual control, then existing oracles; a mechanical assertion always outranks a human one because it is reproducible, which dual control does not provide

userPrinciples.registerClosure: not in this ERC. First judged to need an authority outside the register, then corrected — governance can derive it, and needs no new primitive — then removed entirely with the rest of the governance material as outside what this ERC does

blockerHistory.settlementAuthorityReopened: BLOCKER-1 was withdrawn on 2026-09-02 on the ground that superseding requires owning the token and the griefing case is therefore self-harm. Reopened and fixed on a different ground that the withdrawal does not address: under ownerOf-derived authority the registrar has no way to advance the projection at all, so the register cannot record its own changes without the holder cooperating. The griefing argument is untouched by this change; the authority argument is what the fix answers.
